<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, there are no signals in the typical upfield region for methyl carbons (≈10‑30 ppm). The observed carbon signals are all aromatic (≈120‑140 ppm) or higher-field aliphatic carbons (≈38‑44 ppm), which correspond to other carbon types (e.g., methylene or carbon attached to heteroatoms). Therefore, the molecule contains no CH₃ groups.</thought>
